title: Glitterbomb Trap Catches Phone Scammer (who gets arrested)
summary: Mark Rober sets up elaborate glitter-bomb traps to go after phone scammers, working his way up their chain of command, and ends with a scammer being arrested. He also points viewers to fraud-reporting resources and to scambaiter Jim Browning's investigation.
why: HN mentions it in robocall and scam threads as an entertaining look at how phone scams work and how vigilantes fight back.
